articles.title: Ocon to leave Haas putting F1 future in doubt
articles.description: Esteban Ocon is fighting to save his Formula 1 career after the Haas team announcement that they are splitting with the Frenchman at the end of the year.

articles.title: 'I still feel as fast as anybody' - Alonso on why he's staying in F1
articles.description: Fernando Alonso commits to staying in Formula 1 with Aston Martin for at least one more year. - and explains why to BBC Sport.

articles.title: Ferrari back Vasseur amid speculation over future
articles.description: Ferrari back Frederic Vasseur as their F1 team principal after former Red Bull boss Christian Horner says he would be interested in joining.

articles.title: Does Horner have a chance of Ferrari job? F1 Q&A
articles.description: BBC Sport F1 correspondent Andrew Benson answers your latest questions after the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

articles.title: Norris apologises to Colapinto for ban comments
articles.description: World champion Lando Norris apologises to Franco Colapinto for saying the Argentine should be banned for causing an accident at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
